{{Quote|No such thing as murder in a war. That's part of what makes them so boring. You spend most of your time waiting around between battles, and when they finally happen... it's just a bunch of random killing. I prefer my fights sporting. Or at least interesting.|Shae Vizla|<ref name="Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Shae Vizla''', later '''Mandalore the Avenger''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who gained notoriety during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A ruthless [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], Vizla was often employed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, who made use of her martial skills when undertaking the most risk-intensive missions. She assassinated Republic Senator [[Keenig]], was part of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial force]] [[Battle of Alderaan|attacking]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and launched a strike on a Republic [[Politics/Legends|political]] envoy, during which [[Shae Vizla's brother|Vizla's brother]] was killed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aurei Eadon]], causing her to develop an intense hatred for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. When the Empire launched an [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Vizla was contracted to disable the planet's defense grid, located within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. In conjunction with a frontal assault by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], Vizla infiltrated the Temple, proceeding to [[Death/Legends|kill]] several members of the [[Temple Security Force]]. She successfully completed her mission to disable the defense grid, allowing [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Sith armada]] to strike at Coruscant, and when the attack was over, utilized her [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to fly away from the Temple.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Vizla retired from Imperial service and settled with [[Clan Vizla|her clan]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], cooperating with the [[Nova Blades]] pirates to maintain civil relations in [[Raider's Cove]]. When the Nova Blades aligned with the [[Order of Revan]], Vizla, nicknamed '''"Torch"''' by the locals, broke ties with them and settled on the [[Tracyn Island]] to stay clear of the Revanites. Approached by an individual looking for intel on Revanites, Vizla challenged the intruder in combat and only provided the information after she was defeated in a sparring match. Refusing to let her clan join the all-out war, Vizla nevertheless traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]] to join in a fight against reborn [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] himself.

After the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|invaded]] the galaxy and [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] was slain in battle, Vizla was chosen as the next [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] and reluctantly took up the title ''Mandalore the Avenger''. She united some of the scattered clans and led them in their first victory against Zakuul in many months. Receiving an offer from [[Theron Shan]], the new Mandalore assembled her people for a [[raid on Darvannis]] [[Darvannis factory|weapons factory]] to re-arm themselves. With her second-in-command [[Khomo Fett]] she met [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of [[Eternal Alliance|the Alliance]] that opposed Zakuul, assigning him to work with scout [[Torian Cadera]]. Disabling the factory's shield, perimeter guns and other defenses, the Mandalorians moved inside the factory, with Vizla leading the assault. They were able to claim a large amount of weapons and deal sufficient damage to the factory before Vizla ordered an organized retreat. After the battle, the Mandalore assigned Torian Cadera to act as her representative and liaison within the Alliance, later joining it herself and making their partnership official.

==Biography==
===Bounty hunter===
====Work for the Sith Empire====
{{Quote|Another person who would catch our attention later was the Mandalorian bounty hunter Shae Vizla. She was known to have participated in the Battle of Alderaan, and perhaps indeed she was the one who helped Malgus escape. We cannot know for sure, but we can be certain she survived.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Shae_Vizla_Korriban.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla on Korriban]]
Shae Vizla was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] who spent her youth during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]]. In her younger years, she was earning a living as a ruthless [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], taking high-profile jobs in the pursuit of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]], without a care for her employers' goals.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" /> Following the return of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] from their [[Galactic Standard Calendar|millennia]]-long era of seclusion, and the start of the Great Galactic War between the resurgent [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Ministry of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Sith Imperials]] formed an alliance with the Mandalorian warrior clans,<ref name="Timeline4">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref> one that remained strong under the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|reign]] of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]].<ref name="MtV">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref> Vizla's brutal assassination of Senator [[Keenig]] caught the attention of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], beginning her a partnership with the Sith Empire.<ref name="Codex1">{{TORcite|type=codex|Shae Vizla: Bounty Hunter}}</ref> Her exceptional skill<ref name="DeceivedNovel" /> earned her a reputation that found Vizla commonly employed by the Imperials for heavy-risk operations of a large and important nature.<ref name="Figure">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100609_002-0|text=Limited Edition Bounty Hunter Statue|nolive=1}}</ref> Vizla's skill and efficiency led her to join the Empire's biggest campaigns against the Republic.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Shae Vizla}}</ref>

[[File:Invasion_of_Alderaan.png|thumb|left|250px|Shae Vizla marches alongside Malgus on Alderaan.]]
In [[3667 BBY]], during the heat of the Great Galactic War, Shae Vizla took part in the Sith Empire's [[Battle of Alderaan|attack]] on the peaceful [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="JoMGD" /> Led by Darth Malgus, [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] numbering hundreds of [[Sith Warrior|Sith warriors]], several thousand [[Sith war droid Mark I|assault droids]],<ref name="Hope synopsis">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> and a multitude of [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]] strong, invaded the [[Tree/Legends|arboreal]] world.<ref name="Hope">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> Despite these odds, the Sith were held off by the combined forces of the Republic's [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit, [[Havoc Squad]], and a cadre of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] that included [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="Hope synopsis" /> Shan personally engaged Malgus, defeating and wounding the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], leaving him beneath the rubble of a shattered rock face.<ref name="Hope" /> However, Malgus escaped and returned to the war, and Shan theorized that it had been Vizla who was responsible for the Sith Lord's rescue.<ref name="JoMGD" />

[[File:Vizla_Eadon_JMGD.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla faces Jedi Master Eadon.]]
Three years later, in [[3664 BBY]], Vizla was tasked with [[Mandalorian attack on a Republic envoy|assaulting]] a Republic [[Politics/Legends|political]] envoy. During the course of the attack, [[Shae Vizla's brother|Vizla's brother]] was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aurei Eadon]]. The Mandalorian mercenary challenged Eadon to a duel, seeking to avenge her brother's death, but Eadon refused.<ref name="JoMGD" /> This event caused Vizla to develop an intense hatred for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]], though she kept the reasons behind her bitter feelings to herself.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

====The Sacking of Coruscant====
{{Quote|As this unthinkable battle scene unfolded below, the Mandalorian was navigating the Temple's upper levels and disposing of security personnel. It is unclear how the Imperials knew that Coruscant's security grid mainframe was located in the Temple, but the Mandalorian was most definitely working with extremely accurate intelligence.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
[[File:ShaeShooting.png|thumb|left|250px|Shae Vizla infiltrates the Jedi Temple.]]
In [[3653 BBY]], twenty-eight years after the start of the Great Galactic War, Sith forces contacted the Republic, expressing a desire to negotiate a peaceful resolution to the war. As delegates from both sides met on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to form a peace agreement,<ref name="Timeline1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Shae Vizla was contracted by the Sith Empire to aid in their [[Sacking of Coruscant|surprise assault]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DeceivedNovel" /> Tasked with neutralizing Coruscant's defense grid, located within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]],<ref name="JoMGD" /> Vizla found herself again working with Darth Malgus, in addition to his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|attendant]], [[Eleena Daru]]. Once all three were in position at the Temple, and upon receiving Malgus' order, Vizla infiltrated the ancient ziggurat via a high [[Window/Legends|window]] over the Temple's main entrance.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

[[File:SWTOR_BountyFireAll.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vizla uses her [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] against Temple Security Forces.]]
At the same time, a [[NR2 gully jumper|Republic shuttle]] that had been co-opted by the Sith slammed into the Temple's [[Great Hall (Jedi Temple)/Legends|main hall]] and the [[Sith Warrior|Sith warriors]] within had rushed out to engage the Temple's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defenders,<ref name="DeceivedTrailer" /> in what may have been little more than a distraction designed to allow the Mandalorian infiltrator to go unnoticed.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Inside, Vizla [[Blaster/Legends|shot]] and killed several members of the [[Temple Security Force]] as she made her way to the security grid mainframe. There, she brought down Coruscant's defenses and allowed for the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Sith fleet]] [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by [[Darth Angral]] to begin a planet-wide attack on Coruscant. Following the takedown of the defense mainframe, Vizla flew into the fray in the Temple's lower levels using her [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], where she was responsible for numerous other deaths, of both Temple Security guards<ref name="DeceivedTrailer" /> and [[Republic soldier]]s alike.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

[[File:DeathFromAbove.png|thumb|left|250px|Using her [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]], Shae Vizla fires her [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] on enemies from the air.]]
In the aftermath of the battle for the Jedi Temple, and as the Sith stood victorious over the Jedi, Shae Vizla lingered outside the ruined entrance to the Temple, surveying the damage with her [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] off and held beneath her [[Limb/Legends|arm]]. When she was approached by Malgus, the two nodded to each other in turn. Recognized for her work, Vizla donned her helmet again, and flew away from the burning temple to await her payment from the Empire for services rendered.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

====Retirement on Rishi====
{{Quote|I wouldn't mind it a bit if you chased the Revanites out of Rishi. Off-the-radar is just how we like it here.|Shae Vizla|<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />}}
[[File:Shae_Vizla_on_Yavin_4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Shae Vizla]]
The Sacking of Coruscant led the Republic to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], marking the beginning of a [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which lasted for over a decade.<ref name="Timeline1" /> Vizla continued the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] work, over decades becoming top-tier in her profession, and her list of victories eventually surpassed that of Mandalore the Vindicated himself. Following years of success, Shae started taking fewer and fewer contracts as she became the leader of [[Clan Vizla]]. By the time hostilities between the Republic and the Sith Empire erupted in a new [[Galactic War]], Vizla and her clan had almost completely withdrawn from galactic events, settling on the remote planet of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="Codex" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_on_Tracyn_Island.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Shae Vizla on Rishi]]
The Mandalorians have established a base on the [[Tracyn Island]], on which the warriors could train against each other in the arenas or against the local beasts in the wilderness.<ref name="Blood Hunt">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=flashpoint|Blood Hunt}}</ref> Vizla carefully avoided the war and distanced herself from other Mandalorians, although their presence on Rishi was not a secret to the locals, who nicknamed her "Torch."<ref name="Codex1" /> Clan Vizla helped the [[Nova Blades]] pirates have a good relationship with the people of [[Raider's Cove]] and later, when the [[Order of Revan]] came to Rishi at some point after [[3642 BBY]], briefly allied with them. Vizla and her clan introduced the Revanites to Nova Blades and helped them win a few small engagements, but as their motives to manipulate the Empire-Republic war to their own end came to light, Vizla withdrew her clan from the partnership.<ref name="TOR:HotA">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Heart of the Aggressor|Rishi}}</ref>

[[File:VizlaBloodHunt.png|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla became known as the "Torch" among Rishi locals]]
By [[3637 BBY]]<ref>{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> the Revanites and the Nova Blades had amassed an entire fleet of warships on Rishi.<ref name="Blood Hunt" /> [[Alliance Commander|An associate]] of [[Theron Shan]] and [[Lana Beniko]], who were working against the Revanites, learned about the involvement of "Torch" from the files of [[Dael Margok]], the Nova Blades captain,<ref name="TOR:HotA" /> and traveled to Tracyn Island to ask her for more information. The shuttle was shut down on the approach, and Vizla observed as the outsider set foot on the island, sending a team of her warriors against them. To her surprise, the intruder prevailed and made it inside her Clan's compound, so Vizla set them against several of the beasts her Clan had kept in there. The outsider prevailed once more, and Vizla ordered a Mandalorian couple of [[Jos Beroya|Jos]] and [[Valk Beroya]] to test them in the arena.<ref name="Blood Hunt" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_on_Rishi.png|thumb|250px|left|Shae Vizla meets her challenger in the arena.]]
The Beroyas were defeated, and Vizla, deciding that the fresh face was a worthy challenge for herself, met them at the nearby lava lake, refitted into a battleground. When asked for information about the Revanites and the Nova Blades, Vizla instead demanded a challenge and engaged the intruder. After a prolonged fight, Vizla was beaten, though she complimented her opponent on a decent fight, declaring that it felt good. Feeling that the information was earned, Vizla revealed the existence of the Revanite fleet on Rishi and provided her opponent with a speeder to take them back to Raider's Cove to replace the destroyed shuttle. Before departing, Vizla's opponent asked her to join the fight against the Revanites, but the Mandalorian declined, explaining that she had her fill of war and preferred going toe-to-toe against single strong opponents.<ref name="Blood Hunt" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_and_Darth_Marr.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla with Darth Marr on Yavin 4]]
Vizla's information soon caused the [[Battle of Rishi]], in which the Revanite fleet was neutralized<ref name="TOR:FA">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Frontal Assault|Rishi}}</ref> and a Coalition between Imperial and Republic forces was formed to take down [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] himself.<ref name="TOR:Confederac">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Confederacy|Yavin 4}}</ref> Learning about this, Vizla traveled to the moon of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where she arrived just in time to join an unlikely union of people such as [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Marr]] in a stand against Revan. A prolonged fight ensued, in which Revan was defeated and subsequently became one with the Force, though this also led to the revival of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Vizla then departed from Yavin, though not before renegotiating her Imperial contract with Darth Marr, telling him to let her know where the next fight would be.<ref name="The Enemy Within">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|The Enemy Within|Yavin 4}}</ref>

===Mandalore the Avenger===
====War against Zakuul====
{{Quote|Eternal fleet kept us under siege on the heartworlds. I picked up the title along the way.|Shae Vizla|<ref name="Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Mandalore_the_Avenger_on_Darvannis.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Shae Vizla, Mandalore the Avenger]]
The Coalition led by Darth Marr continued its hunt for the former Sith Emperor, which led to the [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|first skirmish with the Eternal Fleet]] and the subsequent [[Zakuul]]an [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of the galaxy. The Mandalorians fought back, and [[Clan Lok]] was hit hard in return, as Mandalore the Vindicated himself led his forces on the front lines and was ultimately killed in combat with the [[Skytrooper]]s. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] signed treaties with the [[Eternal Empire]], many of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] were blockaded by the [[Eternal Fleet]] and the [[Star Fortress]]es, trapping almost half of Mandalorian clans on those worlds. Most of the other clans had scattered, with Clan Vizla surviving better than most. Her reputation legendary even by Mandalorian standards, Shae Vizla was chosen by leaderless Mandalorians as their new commander and "Mandalore the Avenger," a title she reluctantly accepted.<ref name="KOTFE" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_Mandalore_the_Avenger.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Mandalore the Avenger in her command tent on Darvannis]]
The new position was not an easy one for Vizla, who had spent most of her life as a lone hunter and had very little experience leading people, much less an entire culture. She had to quickly adapt to bring together her people who were beaten down after years of opposing Zakuul, yet her very first battle as Mandalore the Avenger was the clans' first victory in six months. In [[3630 BBY]] Vizla was contacted by an old acquaintance, [[Theron Shan]] from the [[Mestani sector/Legends|Mestani sector]], who offered her and the clans a chance to strike against Zakuul by assembling a [[raid on Darvannis]] [[Darvannis factory|weapons factory]], the taking of which would allow the Mandalorians to re-arm themselves for the first time in years. Assembling a dozen clans, including [[Clan Fett|Fett]], [[Clan Chorn|Chorn]], [[Clan Beroya|Beroya]] and her own, Mandalore Vizla traveled to [[Darvannis]] and laid siege to the factory, placing rotating assault teams of two hundred commandos each around it.<ref name="KOTFE" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire}}
[[File:Khomo_Shae.png|thumb|left|250px|Mandalore the Avenger and Khomo Fett plan the assault on the factory.]]
Vizla and her second-in-command [[Khomo Fett]] were joined by the Commander of [[Eternal Alliance|the Alliance]] that opposed Zakuul&mdash;Vizla's old acquaintance from Rishi. Vizla asked the scout [[Torian Cadera]] to join the Commander in the recapturing of the factory's perimeter guns, while the forward team led by [[Breyer Chorn]] went to take down the energy shield. That wave of assault alone took the lives of twenty-eight warriors, but in the end the factory's shields went down and the inner ring of defenses suffered severe damage. The day coming to close, Mandalorians held a ''[[Kote ky'ram]]'' for the fallen, while celebrating their own survival during the night. The next morning, Shae Vizla and Khomo Fett planned an assault on the factory's power stations, after which they were ready to move inside the factory itself. Vizla shared her battle plan with the Alliance Commander, who added to it by providing the factory's inner schematics, recently procured by Theron Shan.<ref name="KOTFE" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_on_Darvannis.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mandalore the Avenger rallies her troops before the assault.]]
Vizla gave a rallying cry to her warriors and went to lead the assault, while Torian Cadera and the Commander went to retrieve the [[GEMINI Prime]], the reason the Alliance decided to attack the factory in the first place. Inside the factory, the Mandalorians encountered resistance, but were able to claim a large amount of weapons and deal sufficient damage to the factory before Vizla ordered an organized retreat. In the aftermath, Vizla assigned Torian Cadera to act as her representative and liaison within the Alliance, while sharing with the Commander her concern that her warriors would want to reclaim their honor fighting more than droids in the near future.<ref name="KOTFE" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:Mandalore_Avenger_on_Darvannis.jpg|thumb|left|200px|After Darvannis, the Mandalore pledged her forces to the Alliance.]]
After the Alliance Commander was able to strike a massive blow against the Eternal Empire by dethroning Emperor [[Arcann]], the Mandalorians became eager to join their cause. Having her people's support, Vizla decided to make the partnership official and traveled to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]], formally adding her strength and that of her warriors to the Alliance's cause. The Mandalorians, led by Torian Cadera, would go on to fight in the [[Invasion of Voss|liberation]] of [[Voss]] and defend the Alliance base during [[Vaylin]]'s [[Assault on Odessen]].<ref name="KOTET">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

====Further challenges====
After the war had ended and the Eternal Empire was defeated, Shae continue to lead her people within the Alliance, as they assisted in the rebuilding not only their people, but that of the galaxy wrecked by war. With piracy having increased by [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> Mandalore would lead the clans to work with [[Hylo Visz]] to secure supply runs from pirates or anyone else greedy enough during the resource crisis that began to grip the galaxy. As a result no one dared attacked those ships, knowing they were under the watchful protection of Mandalorians.<ref name="Hearts and Minds">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Hearts and Minds|Odessen}}</ref>

[[File:Mandalore_the_Avenger_fights_traitors.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Mandalore the Avenger fights the traitorous Mandalorians.]]
Shae would encounter challenges to her leadership when the [[Third Galactic War]] began. Surviving members of [[Clan Lok]] and others of like mind abandon her leadership before Darvannis and traveled to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], where the formed the [[Ash'ad]] under the leadership of [[Mirli Lok]]. When Mandalore the Avenger discovered their location, she sent Mandalorians to the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] and from there tasked the Alliance Commander to seek out the Ash'ad, wanting them to pay for abandoning the Clans. Shae was determined to see them stripped of their armor and clean the stain of honor to the previous Mand'alor, which in the end proved successful after the Commander found their base in the jungles, eliminating every single member present and stripping their armor from them. Mirli was killed in the process.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Scorn for the Dishonored|Onderon}}</ref>

====The Hidden Chain====
[[File:Mandalore_the_Avenger_and_her_flagship.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Mandalore the Avenger aboard her flagship, the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'']]
In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> Shae Vizla's leadership was put to the test when a hidden renegade Mandalorian group known as the [[Hidden Chain]], led by [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]], came to believe that the Mandalorians under Vizla's rule had lost sight of their ways. Even Clans still loyal to her were starting to feel that they had become glorified couriers by focusing their efforts on protecting cargo supply runs or caravans needing their protection from pirates. Her advisor [[Jekiah Ordo]] continue to voice concerns about the growing unrest among the Clans and believed that they should've crack down harder on them during his investigations to the Hidden Chain's raids on their cargo runs, but Shae remained firm on keeping the Mandalorians freedom and independence, as she did not want to cause further unease.<ref name="Meeting Jekiah Ordo">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Meeting Jekiah Ordo|Odessen}}</ref> Jekiah Ordo took Mandalore's flagship, the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', to lure the mysterious attackers out, but the ship came under [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] by the [[Hidden Chain]] and lost contact with the [[Alliance base]], forcing Mandalore's hand. She recruited the Alliance Commander and Jekiah Ordo's brother, [[Rass Ordo]], to assist her in freeing the ship.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>

[[File:Mandalore_the_Avenger_aboard_Spirit_of_Vengeance_II.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Mandalore the Avenger demands the traitorous Field Marshal to face her.]]
When they arrived, they discovered that Heta Kol had gathered Mandalorian outcast groups such as the [[Dar'manda]], [[Clan Varad]], and the [[Ash'ad]] together into the Hidden Chain and, with their combined ships, had the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'' locked as their boarding parties worked to steal the relics from within the ship. Shae, Rass and the Commander made it to the bridge, where they found the remaining survivors, led by Jekiah Ordo, but Heta Kol stood in their way. Mandalore rushed to initiate a challenge to Heta, and fight ensued, but when members of the Hidden Chain finally found the [[Clan Cadera banner]], Heta made her escape into space, while the loyal Mandalorians were left to recover the damage on the ''Spirit of Vengeance''. Following this, Mandalore proclaimed Jekiah Ordo to be her [[Arbiter (Mandalorians)|arbiter]] and began the search for Heta Kol and the Hidden Chain in the hopes of preventing another [[Mandalorian civil war (disambiguation)|Mandalorian Civil War]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_aboard_Spirit_of_Vengeance_II.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Shae Vizla announces her hunt for Heta Kol.]]
She headed to [[Mek-Sha]] to [[Mission to Mek-Sha (Mandalore the Avenger)|investigate]] [[Indigo (Mandalorian)|Indigo]], the leader of the Dar'manda, whom she believed could help her track down the Hidden Chain,<ref name="Heta Kol Update">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|Heta Kol Update|Shae Vizla}}</ref> though Indigo denied any involvement.<ref name="Not Me">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|IT WASN'T ME|Indigo}}</ref> Eventually, she [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Mandalore the Avenger)|tracked]] Heta to [[Ruhnuk]] but was not willing to risk exposure and thus returned to Odessen for an attack plan.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|Odessen}}</ref> Shae briefed the Alliance Commander on the information she had gathered on Heta Kol, although she was unable to find Heta's past clan affiliations despite her fighting style being Mandalorian. Shae then explained that Ruhnuk was where the [[Hidden Chain]] operated and had put [[Jekiah Ordo]] and her fleet on standby while she, the Commander and [[Rass Ordo]] would infiltrate Ruhnuk to locate the main base.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|A Rock and a Hard Place|Odessen}}</ref>

====Showdown on Ruhnuk====
[[File:Shae_Vizla_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla on Ruhnuk]]
Upon arriving on Ruhnuk, the team had a crash landing as Shae had to evade a probe droid. Shae and the Commander located two technicians hired by Dar'manda and Shae killed one, while the other revealed that the Hidden Chain had a relay station for communications that could cut through interference surrounding the planet. With that knowledge Shae and the Commander went back to Rass to ready a new plan.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|A Rock and a Hard Place|Ruhnuk}}</ref> Rass was joined by [[Akaavi Spar]] and [[Torian Cadera]] and revealed that he may have found a way to locate the relay station and proposed that Shae and the Commander go there while the rest secure their position. At the [[Ruhnuk Communications Tower]], Shae and the Commander confronted [[Sa'har Kateen]], whom Shae demanded to point her to Heta. The Commander attempted to reason with Sa'har, but Shae opened fire and Sa'har took the opportunity to escape from the duo.<ref name="Ruhnuk">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Showdown on Ruhnuk|Ruhnuk}}</ref>

[[File:Mandalore_the_Avenger_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Mandalore the Avenger scouts the Hidden Chain defences.]]
Shae and the Commander dealt with the relay station and went to find Heta Kol.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Outside Interference|Ruhnuk}}</ref> They entered a compound where Shae decided to have a look around only for the doors to close, and the Commander was incapacitated by four sonic weapons. Dar'manda leader [[Bask Sunn]] and Heta Kol confronted the Commander, who remained helpless because of the sonic disruptors until Shae arrived and challenged the leader of the Hidden Chain to a one-on-one combat. Heta agreed and escorted Shae to the battle arena, where with Hidden Chain as the audience, Heta announced that she would destroy the Mandalorians by exposing their weakness and called out for Shae Vizla to come out and face her. Shae loudly expressed her pleasure, calling her opponent a pretender.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

[[File:Mandalore_the_Torch.jpg|thumb|250px|right|"The Torch" proves her name.]]
Both Heta and Shae were presented with Beskar short swords to use as their primary weapons. The duel began and Shae managed to gain the upper hand, but suddenly felt almost paralyzed because of a secret trick pulled by Bask Sunn with one sonic disruptor. Heta took advantage of by pressing the attack with Shae managing to hold off as best as she could. The Commander destroyed the weapon, which freed Shae and allowed her to overpower Heta and win the duel in view by the Hidden Chain. But the scene was interrupted with the arrival of both fleets, and Shae's Mandalorian reinforcements attacked the Hidden Chain thus beginning the full-scale battle.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_after_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Shae Vizla recovers after the Showdown on Ruhnuk.]]
Shae Vizla was left incapacitated while taking out the enemy, and Heta attempted to finish her off, but Shae recovered and was able to fend off Heta's attacks and land a striking blow to Heta who retreated aboard a shuttle. Shae angrily declared that their feud was not over, as the battle ended with the Hidden Chain escaping Ruhnuk to an undisclosed location and Jekiah ordered the fleet to not pursue the enemy. Jekiah and the Commander rallied to Shae Vizla and helped her off Ruhnuk. She was then taken to a medical facility and attended by medical droids. Jekiah and Mandalore discussed how Shae's victory over Heta was spreading throughout the galaxy. Shae was unwilling to disclose that Heta unknowingly cheated via Bask Sunn's sonic disruptor and stated that her hunt was still in-progress.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

====Confronting Darth Malgus====
{{Quote|Shae Vizla.... Your thoughts are plain to me, "Mandalore the Avenger." Your rage consumes you. There was a battle... and your prey slipped between your fingers. Your people are divided, while Heta Kol gathers her army. You are right to come begging for answers... Heta will destroy you.|Darth Malgus taunting Shae Vizla|<ref name="old wounds">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|Carrick Station}}</ref>}}
[[File:Shae_Vizla_in_Old_Wounds.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla's feelings are exposed by [[Darth Malgus]].]]
Shae Vizla arrived on [[Carrick Station]] with the intention of confronting [[Darth Malgus]] on his knowledge, and supposed alliance with, [[Heta Kol]] who now held [[Darth Nul's holocron]] but was stopped by the security droids who only had authorization from the Supreme Chancellor to let certain individuals in the chamber. Shae listened in on the conversation between the [[Alliance Commander]] and Malgus, to which Malgus became aware of Shae's presence and proceeded to, his delight, taunt Shae for letting Heta escape Ruhnuk and how Heta will eventually destroy Shae which led to Shae's outburst at Malgus demanding Heta's location thus signaling the guard droids to deal with Shae if she persists. But Shae calmed down and angrily left the prison.<ref name="old wounds" />

Shae subsequently missing at the time when Jekiah attempted to reach her regarding Hidden Chain attacks across the galaxy.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Chains in the Dark|Carrick Station}}</ref>

====Rekindled Partnership====
{{Quote|Jekiah. I owe you an apology. At the first whisper of betrayal, you said to rein in the clans. I should have listened. But I'll cut you a deal. You don't say "I told you so," and I won't either. We needed someone suited to all the practical nonsense of leadership. I told you that wasn't me. If Heta continues, we lose everything. All of us. The Republic and the Sith will destroy the Mando'ade, no matter whose banner they carry. Shielding us from an outside threat--ensuring our future--is something I can do. It's what I will do. I need to stop Heta, and there's only one person who can tell me how to find her. The reason that Sith besbe'trayc ended up in her hands. Ni ceta, Jekiah. I hope you understand.|Shae Vizla's message to Jekiah Ordo|<ref name="sundering"/>}}
[[File:Shae_Vizla_releases_Darth_Malgus.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Shae Vizla releases Darth Malgus from his prison.]]
Concluding that both the Empire and Republic would destroy the Mandalorians if her war with Heta Kol continued, no matter which banner they carried, Shae hired a team of mercenaries to break into Carrick Station to free Malgus, believing he would know Heta's location. Simultaneously, she sent an audio recording to Jekiah Ordo informing him of her choice and that she would be stepping down as Mandalore. Arriving at Malgus' prison, Shae and her team made quick work of the guard droids before she made her way across to face the rogue Sith. She drew her blaster to destroy the chair and the shield freeing one of the galaxy's most dangerous Sith Lords to which they made their escape via ship.<ref name="sundering" />

[[File:Malgus attacks.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Malgus, Shae, and mercenaries attack the Hidden Chain.]]
Shortly afterwards, the duo and their mercenary team traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Attack on a Hidden Chain base|laid waste]] to the Hidden Chain base and the forces that were stationed on the planet. Upon exiting the base, Shae Vizla bared witness as [[Darth Malgus]] used the Force to execute the last surviving Hidden Chain soldier and two [[Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttle|Scorpion-class Intercept Shuttles]] and then proceeding further.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Threads|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

According to Greb Besrik, both Shae and Malgus are joined hip-to-hip as neither goes without the other indicating a strong sense of partnership or the need to protect the other. It was also revealed that whatever Shae and Malgus desired for would be found in the same place.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Hoth Pursuit|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

[[File:Shae and Malgus.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Shae Vizla and Darth Malgus heading to an unknown destination]]
Sometime later, both Malgus and Shae headed for an unknown destination to further their own agendas.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>

[[File:Malgus_Shae.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla and Darth Malgus depart for Khar Shian]]
At an unknown base, Malgus and Shae's team interrogate several Hidden Chain soldiers until the last one divulged the planet of [[Khar Shian]] as Heta Kol's destination.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Master's Enigma|Odessen}}</ref>

====Death====
{{Quote|Now look at you! Wielding darjetii weapons. (...)''"<br />"''And now that power is mine! I... have made it my own.|Shae Vizsla and Heta Kol|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
Malgus and Shae traveled by ship to Khar Shian to settle scores with Kol, who had joined forces with the exiled [[Darth Jadus]], arriving amidst a joint attack by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Eternal Alliance]], and the Mandalorians under the command of Jekiah Ordo. Malgus bailed out of the ship to pursue his own aims, to the ire of Shae, who continued on into the facility, once [[Naga Sadow's fortress]], on foot after [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Theron Shan]] succeeded in bringing down its [[deflector shield]]. Inside the fortress, she came face to face with the [[Alliance Commander]], Jekiah, and his brother [[Rass Ordo|Rass]], who berated her for abandoning the Alliance.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

The conversation was cut short by the arrival of Heta Kol, armed with [[Naga Sadow's Fortress Blade]]. Shae called her out for the hypocrisy of claiming to be fighting for Mandalorian independence while wielding a Sith weapon, and the foursome attacked Kol. Shae knocked Kol into a nearby crystal, electrocuting her, but received a sword blow through the stomach in turn. She summoned the last of her strength and held Kol against the crystal, electrocuting them both and killing Kol.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

Shae fell, mortally wounded, and was cradled by Jekiah. She exchanged farewells with the Commander, told Rass not to let his brother blame himself for this, and breathed her last.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Today we march. We bleed, exhaust ourselves, and die. Because our true destination will be a battle worth winning!|Shae Vizla|<ref name="KOTFE" />}}
[[File:ShaeVizla-Deceived.png|thumb|180px|right|Shae Vizla in her youth]]
With long [[Color/Legends|red]] hair,<ref name="DeceivedNovel" /> fair skin, and hazel [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="DeceivedTrailer" /> Vizla's soft features belied her physical prowess, which she preferred to enhance with the use of customized [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]]. Vizla was an extremely skilled warrior, as noted by the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darth Malgus, and was capable of gracefully wielding her armor's numerous weapons while maintaining flight via her jetpack during battle. She was comfortable removing her helmet while in the presence of others, but was not so forthcoming as to tell Darth Malgus her name during the times in which they worked together.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

A Mandalorian mercenary, Shae Vizla fought for the promise of credits, selling her martial services for money with little care for the interests and goals of her employers. However, she possessed a personal hatred for Jedi,<ref name="DeceivedNovel" /> which stemmed from the death of her brother at the hands of Jedi Master Aurei Eadon.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Vizla was closed-lipped on the reasons behind her feelings toward the Jedi; despite her hatred, following the sacking of their Coruscant temple, Vizla dispassionately surveyed the damage that had been inflicted by the Sith.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_Torch.jpg|thumb|180px|left|Shae Vizla during her later years]]
In her later years Vizla gained a dislike for war, considering it to be boring, as she preferred to fight battles that were interesting instead of random killing. Her hatred of the Jedi also subsided, and she had no problem working alongside one of them when required.<ref name="Blood Hunt" /> After becoming the new Mandalore, her goals focused on ensuring her people's survival, leading her to have concerns about her right hand [[Khomo Fett]], as she knew he would want to bring back the glory days of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]].<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Equipment==
Shae Vizla wore Mandalorian armor<ref name="DeceivedNovel" /> of primarily gray, over a black [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]]. Her full-face helmet differed from tradition in that it did not<ref name="DeceivedTrailer" /> feature a T-shaped visor.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> Vizla made use of a jetpack possessing two individual thrusters that allowed her periods of sustained flight, and owned at least two [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]],<ref name="DeceivedNovel" /> including one [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that fired red bolts of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]],<ref name="DeceivedTrailer" /> that she was known to wield with deadly accuracy.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla_uses_jetpack.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Shae Vizla utilizes her jetpack.]]
In addition to [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], Shae Vizla also benefited from her armor's [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], the left of which was equipped with a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] [[Holoprojector/Legends|projector]]. Both gauntlets housed miniature [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] capable of producing powerful streams of fire, and each was mounted with a [[Wrist rocket launcher|launcher]] that [[Missile launcher/Legends|fired]] deadly [[Wrist rocket/Legends|missiles]].<ref name="DeceivedTrailer" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You were first introduced to this brutal Bounty Hunter as she joined the Sith fleet in an ambitious assault during the Sacking of Coruscant. Known as Shae Vizla, she is commonly employed by the Empire for large risky undertakings.|[[Gentle Giant Studios|Gentle Giant]] figurine blurb|<ref name="Figure" />}}
Shae Vizla was introduced in the promotional material for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. She first appeared in the ''[[Deceived]]'' cinematic trailer released [[June 1]], [[2009]], in which she had no lines of dialogue, and was not initially named.<ref name="DeceivedTrailer" /> A bounty hunter wearing armor similar to Vizla's, though not initially identified as her, was also seen in the second of ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} trailers entitled [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'']], released on [[June 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="Hope" /> The character remained unnamed until an update on ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website featuring a [[Gentle Giant Studios]] statue of the bounty hunter with a promotional blurb revealing her name,<ref name="Figure" /> and it was only with the release of [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] that Vizla's appearance in the ''Hope'' trailer was confirmed.<ref name="JoMGD" /> She later appeared in the ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' novel, while expanded on the events shown in the ''[[Deceived]]'' trailer.<ref name="DeceivedNovel" />

[[File:Shae_Vizla-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Concept art of Shae Vizla]]
Shae Vizla was also featured in various promotional images as is the archetype character for ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} bounty hunter class, though in some of the concept art she is depicted holding a blaster rifle, a weapon not available to the Bounty Hunter class in-game. Despite her prominence in the pre-release material, Vizla was completely absent from the game at the time of its launch in December [[2011]] and did not make another appearance until the release of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion three years after that. Her appearance in the expansion was foreshadowed in the short story ''[[Bedtime on Concordia]]'' released on the game's website, which mentioned that Vizla withdrew from the major galactic events at some point in the past. Voiced by [[Sumalee Montano]], Shae Vizla appears as a final boss of the "Blood Hunt" flashpoint; along with [[Jos Beroya|Jos]] and [[Valk Beroya]] she is the only in-game boss who does not die in-story after being defeated in a prominent group encounter.<ref name="Blood Hunt" /> She also returns for the fight against [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] on Yavin 4 at the end of the expansion's story.<ref name="The Enemy Within" />

Vizla was then featured prominently in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] Chapter XIV: Mandalore's Revenge, which established her as the new Mandalore and debuted the new look of her armor. During the chapter the player can make a Dark Side choice not to share the factory plans with Vizla, which causes significant Mandalorian losses during the attack on the factory, after which player can make another Dark Side choice to undermine her authority in front of the Mandalorians. Both her original armor and Mandalore the Avenger's armor are available to players from the Cartel Market packs.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Shae Vizla was made available as a companion character exclusively to players who were subscribed on [[October 25]], [[2016]] in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="KotET">{{TORweb|url=eternal-throne/rewards|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne: Rewards|nolive=1}}</ref> She can be used in-game by eligible characters starting at level 1, but story-wise she only joins the player's Alliance after the completion of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Fallen Empire'']] Chapter XIV. If the player made dark-side choices in it, Vizla will note that her position with the clans is weak and joining the Alliance is only way for her to prove her strength.<ref name="KOTET" />

Shae Vizla's surname is similar to that of [[Tor Vizsla|Tor]] and [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], established members of the Mandalorian [[Clan Vizsla/Legends|Clan Vizsla]]. To date, there has been no confirmation of any link between the characters, and Shae's surname lacks the letter "s" present in the names of the other two individuals. Curiously, the surname of [[Gen Vizla]], another member of Clan Vizla, is spelled "Vizsla" in German and French versions of the game client.<ref name="TOR" />
